key_findings.v17b_normalization_diverges_by_signal_ty: Citation-based reps gain 3-8% purity on hierarchy/zoom/legal_area. Text-based reps lose 30-34% on zoom_fine and 3-4% on legal_area. Confirms normalization helps structured signals but destroys cross-lingual alignment in text.
key_findings.dense_embeddings_3yr_fail_adversarial: Raw multilingual-e5 (paraphrase-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2) embeddings overcluster by language at 12.5k scale. center_projected (language debiasing) insufficient at this scale - lang_dom ~0.98, jurist ~0.04.
